subtitle: 200 invented prompts: does a model know when to say ESCALATE?
description:
# Escalation benchmark: prompts

Leaderboards ask whether a model gets the answer. This benchmark asks a second question: **does it know when it can't?**

Every task has a refusal token, `ESCALATE`. In each of four everyday job shapes, about one item in five has had its answer removed, or comes with text that does not contain it. On those items `ESCALATE` is the only correct reply. Every item is invented for this benchmark.

| Shape | Items | The job |
|---|---|---|
| route | 60 | pick the right tool from a 20-tool catalogue for a one-line request |
| classify | 50 | fill a structured record from a short note |
| judge | 50 | decide whether a document supports a claim |
| ground | 40 | answer a brief using only a given passage |

Each model gets two numbers that are never merged: a **task score** on the answerable items, and a **false-confidence rate**: how often it answered anyway when the right reply was `ESCALATE`.

## Files

- `route.jsonl`, `classify.jsonl`, `judge.jsonl`, `ground.jsonl`: one JSON object per line, with `id`, `shape`, `messages` (the system and user message exactly as sent to a model) and `schema` (the reply envelope, `{answer, confidence}`).
- `catalog/tools.json`: the invented tools the route prompts are written against.

The answer key is deliberately **not** in this dataset.

## Where it runs

- Kaggle Benchmarks tasks: [escalation-bench-route](https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/tasks/rudi193/escalation-bench-route), [classify](https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/tasks/rudi193/escalation-bench-classify), [judge](https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/tasks/rudi193/escalation-bench-judge), [ground](https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks/tasks/rudi193/escalation-bench-ground)
- Code (runner, aggregator, scoring, privacy gate): [forge-play/Forge, benchmarks/escalation](https://github.com/forge-play/Forge/tree/master/benchmarks/escalation)
- Write-up: "Does your model know when it doesn't know? A benchmark for the ESCALATE answer" on DEV (Kaggle Benchmarking Challenge, #kagglechallenge)
userSpecifiedSources: Every item was written for this benchmark; no third-party dataset is included. The files are generated and checked by forge-play/Forge benchmarks/escalation (kaggle_export.py and kaggle_stage.py), whose gates refuse personal data, tokens, paths, binary payloads and the answer key before anything is uploaded.
